from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.reporting import payments_between

UTC = timezone.utc


def test_payments_between():
    a = Payment("a", "inv", Decimal("1.00"), created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 2, tzinfo=UTC))
    b = Payment("b", "inv", Decimal("1.00"), created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 5, tzinfo=UTC))
    assert payments_between([b, a], datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026, 1, 3, tzinfo=UTC)) == [a]
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal


@dataclass
class LineItem:
    description: str
    quantity: int
    unit_price: Decimal


@dataclass
class Invoice:
    id: str
    customer_id: str

    invoice_id: str

    status: str = "authorized"  # authorized | captured | voided | refunded

    captured_at: datetime | None = None
    refunded_amount: Decimal = Decimal("0.00")


@dataclass

    customer_id: str
    plan_price: Decimal
    period_days: int
    started_at: datetime
    canceled_at: datetime | None = None
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Subscription


def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    if at < start:
        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
    return period_start, period_start + length
